name: printing_export_reporting_read_models_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0020') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_print_templates') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_print_templates' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_branch_print_defaults' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_print_templates__paper_size' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_branch_print_defaults__branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_branch_print_defaults__print_template' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_branch_settings__default_sales_print_template' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_branch_settings__default_purchase_print_template' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_reporting_daily_branch_metrics' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_reporting_inventory_balances' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_reporting_inventory_balances__warehouse_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_reporting_counterparty_balances' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_reporting_treasury_balances' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_reporting_followup_metrics' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_reporting_followup_metrics__created_count_nonnegative' AND contype = 'c') AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the Printing / Export / Reporting Read Models constraint migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve the normalized print-default authority from ADR-0016 and rebuild reporting projections from their canonical Sources of Truth when needed. Do not drop integrity constraints, rewrite committed migration history, create competing print-default writers, or turn reporting projections into business ledgers. Query/search/performance indexes remain Phase 03.07.
